objective: Validate Full, Fixed Sector, and Adaptive on seven fixed maps after increasing certified stopped local-escape angular resolution from eight to sixteen uniformly spaced directions.

stages.stage1: repetitions 1-5; all 35 triplets must pass infrastructure/source gates before stage2

mode_order: Deterministic rotating order within every triplet.

local_escape_change.before: eight uniformly distributed horizontal directions at 45 degree spacing
local_escape_change.after: sixteen uniformly distributed horizontal directions at 22.5 degree spacing
local_escape_change.unchanged_guards: Every candidate still passes the existing trajectory certificate and stop-viability guard; unsafe candidates remain rejected.

preflight_evidence.forest_full_nominal: Four independent runs completed 5/5 with zero contacts in 57.77-66.33 seconds; minimum body clearance range 0.225-0.297 m.
preflight_evidence.forced_branch: SUPER_TEST_FORCE_LOCAL_ESCAPE_ONCE skipped direction 1/16, committed certified direction 2/16, then completed 5/5 in 58.53 seconds with zero contacts and 0.243 m minimum body clearance.
preflight_evidence.unit_tests: super_planner CTest 4/4 passed after the final source build.

blocking_gate: Stop on any infrastructure/source error, or any Full/Adaptive non-completion, contact, speed violation, or strict recovery-audit failure. Retain Sector safety/non-completion as an outcome if the run is otherwise valid.
required_adaptive_contract: Every completed Full-recovery cycle has exactly one fresh source frame, one committed acknowledgement, one newer certified path and one Sector return; escape-prefix paths retain Full until an ordinary current certificate permits release.
predeclared_metrics: Adaptive Full-open transitions and refresh acknowledgements
claim_limit: Finite simulation evidence on the declared maps; not a population-level or real-world guarantee.
